table.name: TLGNC_PRICING_CALL
table.description: Contains responses for Pricing Call from SAP

column.name: NET_VALUE
column.description: Net value of the order item in target quantity and in uom of the target quantity in currency currency_cd

column.name: TARGET_QUANTITY
column.description: Target quantity in the unit of measure TARGET_QUANTITY_UOM_CD

column.name: ORDER_ITEM_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_PRICING_CALL_OI_ID. Reference to order item.

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_PRICING_CALL_CONTRACT. The contract (Logon identifier!) to which this items belongs.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_PRICING_CALL_MAT. The related material. All relevant attributes of SAP_MAT_COND are contained within this order item (frozen at order creation time).

column.name: SOLDTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_PRICING_CALL_SOLDTO. Sold-To of this order, i.e. the customer (Auftraggeber) of this order.
